releaseNotes: V975 adds operator-facing explanations to the deterministic status cards without changing any deterministic evaluation, AI Grounding validation, runtime, communication, or control behavior.
The AI Grounding card now explains GROUNDED, PARTIAL, and BLOCKED in plain operator language; BLOCKED continues to withhold unsupported AI interpretation while deterministic facts remain visible.
The System Operation card now shows a concise deterministic reason derived only from evaluation fields such as polling, connected ports, faults, alarms, freshness, and explicit signal-quality issues.
All new status-card help text is localized for English, Korean, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, German, and Spanish.

V974 multilingual semantic Grounding guard, V972 AI Data Library, V970 Safe Disconnect, communication, Polling/MAX, PDO/ISDU, Studio Runtime, permissions, HMI read-only, and Signal Tower hardware-control paths are unchanged.

en: Added plain-language help text for GROUNDED, PARTIAL, and BLOCKED.
Added a concise deterministic reason under System Operation.
Operational reason text is derived only from deterministic evaluation fields, never from LLM output.
No change to Grounding validation or protected runtime/control paths.
ko: GROUNDED, PARTIAL, BLOCKED 상태에 사용자가 바로 이해할 수 있는 설명 문구를 추가했습니다.
System Operation 카드 아래에 결정론적 판정 근거를 한 줄로 표시합니다.
Operational Reason은 LLM 출력이 아니라 Polling, Port 연결, Fault, Alarm, Freshness 등 결정론적 필드만 사용합니다.
Grounding 검증 로직과 보호된 Runtime/제어 경로는 변경하지 않았습니다.
ja: GROUNDED、PARTIAL、BLOCKED にオペレーター向けの説明を追加しました。
System Operation カードに決定論的な判定理由を1行で表示します。
Operational Reason は LLM 出力ではなく、Polling、Port 接続、Fault、Alarm、Freshness などの決定論的フィールドのみを使用します。
Grounding 検証ロジックおよび保護された Runtime/制御経路は変更していません。
zh-CN: 为 GROUNDED、PARTIAL 和 BLOCKED 增加了便于操作人员理解的说明。
在 System Operation 卡片下增加一行确定性判定原因。
Operational Reason 仅来自 Polling、Port 连接、Fault、Alarm、Freshness 等确定性字段，不使用 LLM 输出。
未修改 Grounding 验证逻辑及受保护的 Runtime/控制路径。
de: Für GROUNDED, PARTIAL und BLOCKED wurden verständliche Bedienerhinweise ergänzt.
Die Karte System Operation zeigt nun eine kompakte deterministische Begründung.
Der Operational Reason wird ausschließlich aus deterministischen Feldern wie Polling, Port-Verbindung, Faults, Alarmen und Freshness abgeleitet, niemals aus LLM-Ausgaben.
Grounding-Validierung und geschützte Runtime-/Steuerpfade wurden nicht geändert.
es: Se añadieron explicaciones claras para GROUNDED, PARTIAL y BLOCKED.
La tarjeta System Operation muestra ahora una razón determinista resumida.
Operational Reason se deriva únicamente de campos deterministas como Polling, Ports conectados, Faults, Alarmas y Freshness, nunca de la salida del LLM.
No se modificaron la validación Grounding ni las rutas protegidas de Runtime/control.
